ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade health platform featuring rPPG camera-based heart rate sensing and localized multi-language patient intake, specifically designed to bridge the gap between engineering students and the two collaborating healthcare professionals on the team.
ideas.title: MediScan-Triage: Multilingual rPPG & Clinical Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the 50-hour engineering and medical collaboration requirement by integrating hardware/camera sensing with clinical triage workflows, mirroring a proven winning project architecture.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered clinical training simulator using MediaPipe Pose for real-time camera-based CPR coaching and rubric-scored patient interviews for medical professionals and students.
ideas.title: Clinical-Sim CPR & Interview Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages difficult computer vision and pose estimation mechanics that genuinely impress judges looking for hard technical execution beyond basic web wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent AI auditing system that reviews insurance prior authorization decisions or medical AI triage recommendations to detect algorithmic bias and disparities.
ideas.title: ClaimBias-Evaluator for Medical Prior Authorization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced multi-agent architectures that stand out in a crowd of standard LLM chatbots, directly adapting a verified first-place hackathon winning framework.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine tailored for specialized dental and prosthodontic clinics, optimizing patient onboarding and treatment education.
ideas.title: Global-Smile Prosthodontic Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on real-world clinical utility and workflow integration which appeals directly to the practicing medical professionals embedded in hackathon teams.

ideas.pitch: A computer-vision-based biomechanical movement and gait analyzer using MediaPipe and classification models to assist physical therapists in tracking recovery progress.
ideas.title: NeuroGait Biomechanical Movement Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex computer vision tracking that translates easily into a live, interactive demo during the judging phase.
